skills.description: An uploaded document (text/markdown) ingested through the document backend — extracted, chunked, and embedded into one page-with-blocks. Read-only; the original blob is canonical.
A mid-delivery scope change against a project. Re-prices and re-baselines without spawning a new opportunity.
An individual person at a customer. The unit of human relationship.
A buying organisation. Aggregates contacts, engagements, opportunities and projects under one entity.
A document artifact (drive/sharepoint) captured into the knowledge base, often an agent-generated analysis.
An inbound or outbound email artifact captured into the knowledge base from a source channel.
A first-touch interaction with a contact, or the continuous lifecycle spine for an account.
ERP sales orders, mirrored read-only through a sql_view backend over the shipped sources/erp JSON extract. Instances are materialised views — never authored as markdown.
How this knowledge base is organised and how to navigate it. Read this first when entering a new tenant.
A qualified follow-up under BANT. Lives between engagement and opportunity.
A meeting or call recording artifact with a captured transcript, from a calendar/conferencing source.
A named, valued sales motion. The MEDDPICC stage of the funnel.
A buying centre or division inside a customer — the organisational unit an engagement actually lands in, below the legal account.
A delivery engagement spawned at commercial close. Inherits opportunity context as live obligations.
A renewal cycle on a delivered engagement. Qualifies with priors instead of starting cold.
Live market quote for a listed customer/peer, proxied read-only through an openapi backend against the Yahoo Finance chart API. The instance id is the ticker symbol.
A parallel stream of delivery work inside a project or engagement — the unit a delivery team actually plans and tracks against.
